name: 99403 · Clarkston, WA
findings: ZIP 99403 (Clarkston) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99403 (Clarkston) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 99403 (Clarkston) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
